correctness.rationale: The actual package proves cyclic gaps S_i jointly Dirichlet(1,...,1), X_i=1{S_i>r}, K=max(1,Σ X_i) and J=Σ_i X_(i−1)(1−X_i)X_(i+1). Any k specified large-gap exceedances have exact probability p_k=(1−kr)_+^(n−1), including kr≥1. Inclusion–exclusion computes Q=P(B=0), and multiplication of J by B gives 2(p2−p3)+(n−3)(p3−p4) for each cyclic summand. Therefore Cov=n[2(p2−p3)+(n−3)(p3−p4)−(np1+Q)(p2−p3)], valid even B=0,1. Expanding p_k at r=c/n to order 1/n and bounding Q exponentially yields the stated factored limit; e^c>1+c² makes its sign change unique at log(3/2). Independent exact rational enumeration of all gap masks on twelve (n,r) strata matched the full finite identity. Finite masks corroborate rather than establish the limiting asymptotic.
residual_risks: Sparse sign refers to limit of covariance divided by n, not uniform finite-n crossover uniqueness.
Physical geodesic edges across a long gap would require the alternate circular path shorter than r, impossible if at least two long gaps; the one-long-gap connected case is treated separately.

originality.rationale: The source model is the classical equal-length random-arc covering of a circle. Huillet (2003), Theorem 7, studies physical lengths of connected arc clusters, not the number of sampled vertices in clusters of size two jointly with total cluster count. The fixed-binomial Dirichlet-gap inclusion–exclusion identities are elementary prior methods, not claimed as novel. The exact mixed covariance and fixed-length-corrected sign crossover are the surviving contribution.

value.rationale: Mixed component-count dependence is a natural structural statistic in one-dimensional random geometric graphs. Its exact finite covariance and unique sparse sign reversal reveal the geometric fixed-total-length correction and the same parameter that maximizes two-point-component density, a motivated full-parameter result rather than arbitrary enumeration.
residual_risks: Not a joint CLT or higher-dimensional generalization; physical-cluster-length statistics are distinct.

final_claim: For n≥4 iid uniform circle points and 0<r<1/2, exact Cov(total component count K,two-vertex component count J) follows from long-gap Dirichlet exceedances; for r=c/n the normalized limit is e^(−2c)(3e^(−c)−2)((1+c²)e^(−c)−1) with unique sign crossover at log(3/2).
limitations: Uniform iid points on the unit circle, geodesic hard-threshold graph, components with exactly two vertices.
Finite-n signs need not match limiting signs near the critical parameter.
